    "Sentiment turning negative (-0.33) causes model to overforecast by ~0.1-0.2 units relative to true prices",
    "Model exhibits mean-reversion bias, forecasting toward historical means rather than capturing genuine price momentum",
    "Positive sentiment amplifies forecast accuracy gap, with underforecast errors increasing as sentiment strength grows",
    "When prices are consolidating within 1-2 unit range, model overfits to recent mean rather than anticipating next price move",
    "Sentiment turning from positive to negative corrects model's direction by ~0.1-0.2 units per day"
] }
